# Find next income date next_income_date = None next_income_amount = 0 for income in self.manager.income_sources: next_pay = income.get_next_pay_date(today - timedelta(days=1)) if next_income_date is None or next_pay < next_income_date: next_income_date = next_pay next_income_amount = income.amount
if next_income_date is None: next_income_date = today + timedelta(days=30)
# Calculate bills due before next income bills_before_income = [] total_bills_due = 0 for bill in self.manager.bills: next_due = bill.get_next_due_date(today - timedelta(days=1)) if next_due <= next_income_date: bills_before_income.append((next_due, bill)) total_bills_due += bill.amount
# Calculate promo payments needed (urgent ones) promo_payments_needed = 0 urgent_promos = [] for bank in self.manager.banks: for credit in bank.get_all_credit_accounts(): for promo in credit.active_promos: balance = credit.promo_balance.get(promo.promo_name, 0) if balance > 0: days_left = (promo.end_date - today).days if days_left <= 60: # Urgent if expiring within 60 days months_left = max(days_left / 30, 0.5) monthly_needed = balance / months_left urgent_promos.append({ 'name': promo.promo_name, 'balance': balance, 'days_left': days_left, 'monthly': monthly_needed }) promo_payments_needed += monthly_needed
# Calculate minimum credit payments min_credit_payments = sum( credit.calculate_minimum_payment() for bank in self.manager.banks for credit in bank.get_all_credit_accounts() )
# Calculate safe-to-spend reserved_for_bills = total_bills_due reserved_for_credit = min_credit_payments reserved_for_promos = promo_payments_needed buffer = 100 # Safety buffer
safe_to_spend = total_cash - reserved_for_bills - reserved_for_credit - reserved_for_promos - buffer
# Display results print(f"\n Today: {today.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}") print(f" Next payday: {next_income_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')} ({(next_income_date - today).days} days)") print(f" Expected: ${next_income_amount:,.2f}")
print(f"\n CURRENT CASH: ${total_cash:,.2f}")
print(f"\n BILLS DUE BEFORE NEXT PAYDAY: ${total_bills_due:,.2f}") bills_before_income.sort(key=lambda x: x[0]) for due_date, bill in bills_before_income[:5]: days_until = (due_date - today).days print(f" • {due_date.strftime('%m/%d')} ({days_until}d): {bill.bill_name} - ${bill.amount:,.2f}") if len(bills_before_income) > 5: print(f" ... and {len(bills_before_income) - 5} more")
print(f"\n MIN CREDIT PAYMENTS: ${min_credit_payments:,.2f}")
if urgent_promos: print(f"\n⚠️ PROMO PAYOFFS NEEDED: ${promo_payments_needed:,.2f}/mo") for p in urgent_promos: print(f" • {p['name']}: ${p['balance']:,.2f} ({p['days_left']} days left)")
print(f"\n️ SAFETY BUFFER: ${buffer:,.2f}")
print(f"\n{'='*50}") if safe_to_spend >= 0: print(f"✅ SAFE TO SPEND: ${safe_to_spend:,.2f}")
# Suggest allocation weekly_budget = safe_to_spend / max((next_income_date - today).days / 7, 1) daily_budget = safe_to_spend / max((next_income_date - today).days, 1) print(f"\n Weekly budget: ${weekly_budget:,.2f}") print(f" Daily budget: ${daily_budget:,.2f}") else: print(f"❌ SHORTFALL: ${abs(safe_to_spend):,.2f}") print(f"\n ⚠️ You may need to defer some bills or reduce spending")
print(f"{'='*50}")

def _monthly_spending_summary(self): """Show monthly spending breakdown.""" print("\n" + "-" * 80) print("MONTHLY SPENDING SUMMARY") print("-" * 80)
# Calculate monthly totals - properly convert all frequencies to monthly total_fixed_bills = sum(bill.amount for bill in self.manager.bills)
# Calculate monthly income with proper frequency conversion total_income = 0.0 income_details = []
for income in self.manager.income_sources: # Convert to monthly amount based on frequency if income.frequency == IncomeFrequency.WEEKLY: monthly_amount = income.amount * 52 / 12 # ~4.33 per month freq_display = f"${income.amount:,.2f}/week" elif income.frequency == IncomeFrequency.BIWEEKLY: monthly_amount = income.amount * 26 / 12 # ~2.17 per month freq_display = f"${income.amount:,.2f}/biweekly" elif income.frequency == IncomeFrequency.SEMIMONTHLY: monthly_amount = income.amount * 2 # 2x per month freq_display = f"${income.amount:,.2f} x2" elif income.frequency == IncomeFrequency.MONTHLY: monthly_amount = income.amount freq_display = f"${income.amount:,.2f}/mo" elif income.frequency == IncomeFrequency.QUARTERLY: monthly_amount = income.amount / 3 freq_display = f"${income.amount:,.2f}/quarter" elif income.frequency == IncomeFrequency.YEARLY: monthly_amount = income.amount / 12 freq_display = f"${income.amount:,.2f}/year" else: monthly_amount = income.amount freq_display = f"${income.amount:,.2f}"
total_income += monthly_amount income_details.append({ 'name': income.source_name, 'monthly': monthly_amount, 'display': freq_display, 'frequency': income.frequency.value })
# Credit minimums min_credit = sum( credit.calculate_minimum_payment() for bank in self.manager.banks for credit in bank.get_all_credit_accounts() )
# Mortgage payments total_mortgage = sum( mortgage.total_monthly_payment for bank in self.manager.banks for mortgage in bank.get_all_mortgage_accounts() )
total_obligations = total_fixed_bills + min_credit + total_mortgage discretionary = total_income - total_obligations
print(f"\n MONTHLY INCOME: ${total_income:,.2f}") for detail in income_details: print(f" • {detail['name']}: ${detail['monthly']:,.2f}/mo ({detail['display']}, {detail['frequency']})")
print(f"\n FIXED OBLIGATIONS: ${total_obligations:,.2f}") print(f" Bills: ${total_fixed_bills:,.2f}") for bill in sorted(self.manager.bills, key=lambda b: b.amount, reverse=True)[:5]: print(f" • {bill.bill_name}: ${bill.amount:,.2f}") if len(self.manager.bills) > 5: print(f" ... and {len(self.manager.bills) - 5} more")
if total_mortgage > 0: print(f" Mortgages: ${total_mortgage:,.2f}")
print(f" Min Credit Payments: ${min_credit:,.2f}")
print(f"\n{'='*50}") print(f" DISCRETIONARY (Groceries, Personal, etc): ${discretionary:,.2f}") print(f" Weekly: ${discretionary/4:,.2f}") print(f"{'='*50}")
if discretionary < 0: print(f"\n⚠️ WARNING: Expenses exceed income by ${abs(discretionary):,.2f}")

months = int(input("\nAnalyze for how many months? [3]: ").strip() or "3")
end_date = date.today() + timedelta(days=30 * months) result = self.manager.project_balances(end_date=end_date)

monthly_income = total_income / months monthly_expenses = total_expenses / months monthly_discretionary = monthly_income - monthly_expenses
print(f"\n {months}-MONTH PROJECTION:") print(f" Average monthly income: ${monthly_income:,.2f}") print(f" Average monthly expenses: ${monthly_expenses:,.2f}") print(f" Average discretionary: ${monthly_discretionary:,.2f}")
# Suggest budget categories print(f"\n SUGGESTED BUDGET ALLOCATION:") groceries = monthly_discretionary * 0.40 personal = monthly_discretionary * 0.25 entertainment = monthly_discretionary * 0.15 savings_extra = monthly_discretionary * 0.20
print(f" Groceries (40%): ${groceries:,.2f}") print(f" Personal (25%): ${personal:,.2f}") print(f" Entertainment (15%): ${entertainment:,.2f}") print(f" Extra Savings (20%): ${savings_extra:,.2f}")
